name: tradera-mcp
description: Tradera (automotive): get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_tradera_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADERA_APP_ID
platform_mcp_tradera_app_id.description: Application ID (integer) of an app registered in the Tradera Developer Center (self-service).

platform_mcp_tradera_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADERA_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_tradera_app_key.description: Application key (GUID) of that app. Read-only calls (search, items, categories) need only these two headers.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /v4/items/{itemId} with X-App-Id/X-App-Key (REST v4, beta). price is the Buy Now price (SEK, integer); auction state (maxBid, nextBid, totalBids, endDate), attributeValues, imageLinks and seller stay in raw.
